blurb: An agent is addressed by its key, so constructing one takes exactly one argument: the value of its single `key` field. `Counter("a")` names the instance with key `"a"`. Two arguments or none do not say which instance is meant. Pass the one key. A key of the wrong type is `bynk.agent.key_mismatch`.
summary: An agent was constructed with the wrong number of key arguments.
